prompts.template: Summarise this Kalika Enterprises customer interaction in 2 sentences. Return JSON: {"summary":str,"sentiment":"positive|neutral|negative","intent":"order|rate|complaint|feedback|other","next_action":str}. Interaction: {text}

sample_input.text: Customer asked for 500 kg VCI bags at Rs.182/kg, wants delivery before Diwali, and mentioned last shipment was 2 days late.

expected_output.summary: Customer needs 500 kg VCI bags at Rs.182/kg before Diwali and flagged a 2-day late delivery last time.
expected_output.next_action: Send quote with delivery date and apologise for last delay

prompts.template: Given customer type '{customer_type}', current stage '{stage}', and recent events {events}, choose the single best next action from the allowed templates {allowed_templates}. Return JSON: {"template_id":str,"reason":str,"send_in_hours":int}.

expected_output.reason: Customer asked for rates at the interest stage; rate share converts fastest.

prompts.template: Extract behaviour patterns from this customer journey log. Return JSON: {"patterns":[{"name":str,"evidence":str,"confidence":float}],"dropout_risk":"low|medium|high"}. Journey: {log}

sample_input.log: new customer -> welcome sent -> catalogue opened twice -> rate asked -> no reply for 9 days

prompts.template: Review last week's prompt outcomes: {outcomes}. Propose at most 3 minimal edits to improve reply rate. Return JSON: {"edits":[{"prompt_id":str,"change":str,"reason":str}],"confidence":float}.

sample_input.outcomes: PR-01 summary 92% accepted; PR-02 next-step 61% reply; PR-03 unused

prompts.template: Write a 2-line WhatsApp follow-up for Kalika customer {customer} whose order {order_no} is {pct}% dispatched (balance {balance} qty). Polite, no emojis, include reply instruction.
prompts.expected_output: Namaste WHITE POLLY ji, your order LOC-20261030-014 is 66.7% dispatched with 7,473 qty balance planned next. Reply here for any change in quantity or delivery schedule.
